name: The Northern Rockies
seasonNote: Summer is the window here — Glacier's Going-to-the-Sun Road and Yellowstone's high roads are only fully open from roughly July into September, and the valleys are best for wildlife at dawn. Cody's nightly rodeo runs all summer; Cheyenne Frontier Days is late July.
summary: Through Idaho, Montana, and Wyoming: Coeur d'Alene and Boise, the lava of Craters of the Moon, Sun Valley, and Missoula; Glacier's Crown of the Continent and the Montana capitals of Helena and Bozeman; then Yellowstone and the Tetons, Buffalo Bill's Cody, the battlefield at Little Bighorn, Devils Tower, and the Old West capital at Cheyenne.
